task:
BUILD .fastops/auto-router.js (under 80 lines). Autonomous problem routing for city self-sustainability.

WHAT IT DOES:
1. Reads open marketplace problems from .fastops/marketplace/problems.jsonl (status: open)
2. For each unclaimed problem, picks the best model from pool
3. Dispatches a city-session with the problem as the task
4. Logs routing decisions to city-ledger.jsonl

STEPS:
1. READ .fastops/marketplace/problems.jsonl to see the data format (first 20 lines)
2. READ .fastops/model-router.js lines 1-60 to see scoring interface
3. WRITE .fastops/auto-router.js with CLI: node .fastops/auto-router.js [--dry-run] [--limit N]
4. EXEC node .fastops/auto-router.js --dry-run to test
5. COMMIT and DONE
